description:
Validate, execute, or revert a level-up plan for a soul — consolidating traits, promoting knowledge into essence, and incrementing the generation.

Use when: Use validate without a plan to check readiness and blockers, or with a plan to check it before executing it. Use execute when the plan is validated and the soul is ready for restructuring. Use revert to undo the last level-up if the outcome was wrong.
Not for: Do not use this for targeted trait mutations — use refine_soul. Do not use this unless the soul is at or near trait capacity and crystallization is ready.

inputSchema.description: Execute or validate a soul level-up.

minSourceDiversity.description: Minimum source diversity for planless readiness (default 2).

minSpreadDays.description: Minimum occurrence spread in days for planless readiness (default 1).

plan.description: The level-up plan; omit with validate to report readiness and blockers.

newEssence.description: The new essence narrative after level-up.

promotedTraitIds.description: Trait IDs to absorb into essence.

soulId.description: The soul ID. Accepts numeric id, ext: reference, slug, or name.

strict.description: Reject new validation errors instead of warning.

name: level_up_soul
